scripts.test:emulators: npx -y firebase-tools@15.29.0 emulators:exec --only firestore,storage "npm run test:rules"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.load:accounts:emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && npx -y firebase-tools@15.29.0 emulators:exec --only firestore "node scripts/load-accounts-emulator.mjs"
scripts.test:chests:emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && npx -y firebase-tools@15.29.0 emulators:exec --only firestore "node scripts/test-chests-emulator.mjs"
scripts.test:ranking-security:emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && npx -y firebase-tools@15.29.0 emulators:exec --only firestore "node scripts/test-ranking-security-emulator.mjs"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,storage
scripts.deploy:apphosting: npx -y firebase-tools@15.29.0 apphosting:rollouts:create recompensa-premiada --project premios-14238 --git-branch main --force
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run cap:check && cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run cap:check && cap sync ios
